Gandhi Jayanti observed with events across India

Across India, Gandhi Jayanti and Lal Bahadur Shastri Jayanti were observed on October 2nd. In Nainital, teachers managed traffic arrangements during a Prabhat Pheri (morning procession) as police personnel were reportedly absent. In Varanasi, a Ganga Aarti and ghat cleaning event paid tribute to Mahatma Gandhi and Shastri. In Ghaziabad's DPS Indirapuram, the events focused on messages of cleanliness and responsibility.
